Because of the increasing popularity of 8 mm. motion pictures, and to
meet the frequent requests of our many passengers for fine travel films
they can show at home,
TWA has produced a new series of motion
pictures... the TWA Official Library of 8 mm. Film Travelogs in Color.
Fourteen different subjects are now available showing the highlights
and scenic attractions of the areas served by TWA.
We have taken
footage made by some of the world's most skilled cameramen, and have
produced 8 mm. films using the finest quality techniques of reduction
optical printing. The result is a clarity and color rarely achieved in
8 mm. film.
Now you can be there... the changing of the Guard at
Buckingham Palace... the mighty Matterhorn rearing its
.. the breathtaking beauty of the
Taj Mahal... the grandeur of the Parthenon... more than
900 exciting scenes like these are now available in this
new "Flight To...
See the complete scene list-
ings for each of these films on the left and right flaps.

and editing their own films, TWA is also making avail-
able a reel devoted solely to selected scenes of your TWA
StarStream Jet, in flight and at the airport. Full details
about this reel appear on the back panel.

SELECTED SCENES OF THE TWA STARSTREAM* JET
Here are the scenes practically impossible for you to photograph. Never before
available in such superb 8 mm. color quality and clarity.
TW-850 • STARSTREAM JETS • 18 SCENES
The TWA New York Flight Center ... servicing and
loading plane at Jetway... passengers boarding...
TWA StarStream Jet taxiing out onto runway... the
actual take-off (l. to r.) ...jet flying serenely above
the clouds... landing... take-off again ... air-to-air
in-flight scenes against blue sky and flufly white
clouds...cockpit - pilot at controls...movies in flight
...cabin interior with hostess... view through cabin
window...landing...taxiing in...passengers deplaning.
Obviously, many of these scenes could be obtained only by aerial photographers,
shooting trom another plane. This TWA 100 foot Stock Film Reel has
18 different scenes and runs for over five minutes. In addition to magnificent
color fidelity, these scenes are especially prepared so they can be spliced into
your own original travel films without loss of focus because the emulsions are
on the same side. Edit these scenes into your own movies — create a more pro-
fessional production with these dramatic in-flight and exterior shots. Order the
TWA Stock Film Reel listed on the order blank inside. Available now at a
Special Low Price, $7.95. *TWA StarStream is a service mark owned exclusively by Trans World Airlines, Inc.
